situations.title: FDA agreement on Phase III FAP trial endpoint
situations.summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals reached an FDA agreement on a key endpoint for its Phase III FAP trial. The trial outcome is pending, and success or failure will significantly impact the stock.

situations.summary: TeraWulf's CEO stated he won't rush a lease deal for the Muskie site in a 'terrible market', while peers Applied Digital and Core Scientific have secured or are pursuing large hyperscaler leases. situations.title: CrowdStrike acquisition of Zscaler
situations.summary: CrowdStrike announced a $44B deal to acquire Zscaler. The deal is pending regulatory and shareholder approval, with integration risks.

situations.title: EU opens antitrust probe into CCEP
situations.summary: The European Commission has opened an antitrust investigation into Coca-Cola Europacific Partners over cross-border beverage trade practices. The probe could lead to fines or forced changes to business practices, creating uncertainty for the stock.

situations.title: Bay du Nord project approved, FID pending
situations.summary: Canada and Newfoundland approved the $14B Bay du Nord offshore oil project development plan, but final investment decision (FID) is still pending. Equinor also recently contained a cyberattack. The stock has fallen sharply amid broader energy weakness.

situations.title: GTCR potential takeover of Global Payments
situations.summary: GTCR is reportedly considering a $50 billion buyout bid for Global Payments. The deal is not yet agreed or accepted, and the outcome is unresolved.

situations.title: Semtech Q3 earnings report due after close
situations.summary: Semtech reports fiscal Q3 earnings after market close on Nov 23. The stock has fallen sharply from its 52-week high amid supply chain concerns and analyst target cuts. The report will test whether the AI data center growth story remains intact.
